messages:
zane: Heads up  short release-train bulletin: planned maintenance Sunday 03:00-06:00 UTC. We'll do a quick kernel patch on inference hosts and tilt canary traffic to us-central for ~45m at ~04:00 UTC. Please post any exception requests by 22:00 PT today.

marta: Which services are in-scope?

zane: In-scope: inference-core, model-cache, routing-proxy. Out-of-scope: dashboard, export-worker. We will avoid customer-dedicated pools unless unavoidable.

cleo: We have a small rerank rollout finishing Sun morning (owner: cleo). It does not touch quant kernels. Requesting exception to finish ramp.

zane: Please add a short risk note. Low-risk, kernel-free rollouts are usually allowed.

cleo: Exception filed: rerank-final (owner: cleo) - smoke passed on canary, no kernel/quant libs.

deploy-bot: Exception received: rerank-final. Exception ID: RTX-421. Auto-rollouts permitted for this rollout only. :white_check_mark:

harper: Ops - what's the tilt command so I can update the runbook?

ops-bot: Tilt command: `routingctl tilt --from global-canary --to us-central-tilt --percent 70 --duration 45m`

zane: We'll also provision 2 helper GPU nodes in us-central for the tilt. Command pinned to runbook: `infractl provision --zone us-central1 --type gpu-small --count 2 --ttl 2h`

cleo: I'll queue a post-tilt smoke-run and report results here.

zane: Fallback policy added for clarity:
```
trigger: error-rate > 1.2% sustained 3m OR p95 latency increase > 50%
action: stop canary ramp, route -> model:stable, notify -> #incidents, run rolling restart on routing-proxy
```

harper: ops note: we'll avoid touching dedicated pools. If any denylist appears, we'll abort and fallback immediately.

deploy-bot: Scheduled actions created: banner-add (2147620800), provision-us-central (2147621400), tilt-us-central (2147621600)

zane: Final reminder: post exception requests by 22:00 PT. If you need emergency exceptions after that, escalate to @oncall with rollback playbook. I'll post the console banner text shortly. :loud_sound:
